key_insight: Mangrove drag is not well captured by uniform vegetation models because root biomass varies vertically, and this variation creates species-dependent, frequency-selective wave attenuation.
engineering_relevance: The paper provides a generalized mangrove parametrization and a simplified drag-preserving representation that can be used in CFD simulations and physical test models for coastal protection design.
method: Derive a generalized vertical vegetation profile for multiple mangrove species.
Formulate a wave attenuation model that explicitly includes mangrove root characteristics.
Implement a simplified mangrove representation that reproduces a prescribed drag-force profile.
evidence_signal: The proposed model was evaluated with OpenFOAM simulations, showing species-dependent, nonlinear wave attenuation behavior.
watch_item: The model’s accuracy depends on capturing real root-profile variability, so oversimplified parameter choices may miss important drag and attenuation effects.
paper_title: On the Modelling of the Hydrodynamic Drag of Mangroves
